resources.string: Allows SplitMe to request the Android system split-screen toggle when you tap its Quick Settings tile. It does not read screen content or collect data.
Enable the SplitMe accessibility service to use the Quick Settings tile. The service is used only to request the Android split-screen toggle.
HyperOS does not currently expose the split-screen accessibility action. Use the Recent Apps split-screen option on your phone instead.
Android could not start split-screen. Try from Recent Apps and choose a compatible app.
Could not launch the split-screen shortcut. Please try again.

Setup: 1. Enable the SplitMe accessibility service below. 2. Open Quick Settings by swiping down twice. 3. Tap Edit, find Split Screen, and add the tile. 4. Open an app, tap the Split Screen tile, then use the phone system UI to choose the second app if prompted.
Android and HyperOS decide whether the split-screen action is available. This app cannot force unsupported apps into split-screen.
